TSVFACING.LockArtL: Force lockRotation on every token so artwork never turns with movement. Facing is still recorded and is shown by the arrow.
TSVFACING.ShowArrowL: Draw an arrow on the token ring pointing the way the token is facing.
TSVFACING.ColorL: Hex colour used when 'Arrow colour source' is set to Fixed colour.
TSVFACING.SizeL: Arrow length as a fraction of the token radius (0.03-0.60).
TSVFACING.HostileOnlyN: Only on tokens I can see facing for
TSVFACING.HostileOnlyL: Hide the arrow on tokens the current user does not own or observe.
TSVFACING.NoArrowL: Hide the facing arrow for this creature - for things with no meaningful front, such as multiple heads, swarms, oozes or spheres.
TSVFACING.ColorModeL: Match the token's border colour (disposition, and the selection colour while selected), sample the ring drawn into the token artwork itself, or use one fixed colour.
TSVFACING.DistanceL: Fixed distance from the token centre, as a fraction of the token radius. Used only when 'Place arrow automatically' is off.
TSVFACING.AutoDistanceL: Measure how far each token's artwork actually reaches and sit the arrow just outside it. Handles inset disc tokens and full-frame art alike. Turn off to use one fixed distance for every token.
TSVFACING.MarginL: Extra gap between the edge of the artwork and the BASE of the arrow, as a fraction of the token radius. 0 rests the base directly on the edge.
TSVFACING.TokenColorL: Override the arrow colour for this creature only. Leave blank to use the world setting.
